creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = [c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
spotify_username='cheweber@gmail.com'
print('spotify_username', spotify_username)
print('spotify_pw_len', len(spotify_pw))
spotify_login = apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_username, password=spotify_pw)
print(spotify_login)

access_token = spotify_login['access_token']
liked_song_ids = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index)
    if not page:
        break

    liked_song_ids.extend([item['song_id'] for item in page])
    page_index += 1
print('liked_song_ids_count', len(liked_song_ids))

access_token = spotify_login['access_token']
# Use previously computed variables from prior execution: song_to_like, album_to_like
song_to_like_ids = song_to_like
album_to_like_ids = album_to_like

song_results = []
for sid in song_to_like_ids:
    res = apis.spotify.like_song(song_id=sid, access_token=access_token)
    song_results.append({'song_id': sid, 'res': res})

album_results = []
for aid in album_to_like_ids:
    res = apis.spotify.like_album(album_id=aid, access_token=access_token)
    album_results.append({'album_id': aid, 'res': res})

# Summarize
song_success = sum(1 for r in song_results if 'message' in r['res'])
song_fail = len(song_results) - song_success
album_success = sum(1 for r in album_results if 'message' in r['res'])
album_fail = len(album_results) - album_success

print('song_like_attempts', len(song_results))
print('song_like_success', song_success)
print('song_like_fail', song_fail)
print('song_like_first_failures', [x for x in song_results if 'message' not in x['res']][:3])

print('album_like_attempts', len(album_results))
print('album_like_success', album_success)
print('album_like_fail', album_fail)
print('album_like_first_failures', [x for x in album_results if 'message' not in x['res']][:3])

access_token = spotify_login['access_token']

# Fetch liked songs after actions
new_liked_song_ids = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    new_liked_song_ids.extend([item['song_id'] for item in page])
    page_index += 1
new_liked_song_set = set(new_liked_song_ids)

# Fetch liked albums after actions
new_liked_album_ids = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_albums(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    new_liked_album_ids.extend([item['album_id'] for item in page])
    page_index += 1
new_liked_album_set = set(new_liked_album_ids)

# Retrieve expected sets from earlier computations
expected_song_to_like = set(song_to_like)
expected_album_to_like = set(album_to_like)
initial_liked_song_set_local = set(liked_song_set)
initial_liked_album_set_local = set(liked_album_set)

missing_songs = sorted(expected_song_to_like - new_liked_song_set)
missing_albums = sorted(expected_album_to_like - new_liked_album_set)

print('initial_liked_songs_count', len(initial_liked_song_set_local))
print('expected_song_to_like_count', len(expected_song_to_like))
print('new_liked_songs_count', len(new_liked_song_set))
print('missing_song_count', len(missing_songs))
print('missing_song_ids', missing_songs)

print('initial_liked_albums_count', len(initial_liked_album_set_local))
print('expected_album_to_like_count', len(expected_album_to_like))
print('new_liked_albums_count', len(new_liked_album_set))
print('missing_album_count', len(missing_albums))
print('missing_album_ids', missing_albums)

# Also check if any were liked beyond expected (should not be a problem)
extra_songs = sorted(new_liked_song_set - (initial_liked_song_set_local | expected_song_to_like))
extra_albums = sorted(new_liked_album_set - (initial_liked_album_set_local | expected_album_to_like))
print('extra_song_count', len(extra_songs))
print('extra_song_ids_sample', extra_songs[:10])
print('extra_album_count', len(extra_albums))
print('extra_album_ids_sample', extra_albums[:10])
